name: Subscribe prompt: lower-left signature
when: The voice asks to subscribe. Put it on a calm, good-looking shot; it doesn't stop the video.
anchor: The press (`press`) lands on the word "subscribe".

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.channel: the channel name from the channel kit; empty = no name
vars.avatar: the profile picture file from the channel kit, copied into the project's assets/; empty = no circle
vars.done: button text after the press, default Subscribed
vars.press: seconds after the start: when the voice says "subscribe" (at least 1.1)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.4 s later)

changed: The name and button unroll in 15 frames instead of 16 (entry 0.5 s). The lab monogram is now the channel picture from the kit; with no picture there is no circle and the row starts on the edge. The bottom-left dim is a layer of the template instead of baked into the footage.
